A REAL REQUEST. A VISIBLE RESULT.

From CSV to conversation.

  1. Download and upload the fictional Q3 CSV, or use the sample button.
  2. Create a Gemini API key using a Free Tier project in Google AI Studio.
  3. Ask for next month’s revenue forecast. The app sends validated monthly values, your question, and recent chat context to Google.
  4. Gemini selects and orders supported UI components. The app validates the JSON before rendering. Follow-up messages revise the current dashboard.

The forecast is a locally calculated linear trend. It uses all uploaded months and predicts one month ahead. It does not model seasonality, market changes, or uncertainty.

Nothing is stored by this app. Google receives the request and applies its own data policy. Your API key is held only in page memory; clear it or close the page when finished. For shared production use, move the key and inference calls to an authenticated backend.

Provider errors are shown explicitly. The app never substitutes a fake AI response or silently changes providers.
